title: Expenses
subtitle: Record project costs and business expenses in one place.

capture.title: New expense
capture.subtitle: Enter an amount to save. Everything else is optional.

promoteVendor.title: Save as vendor
promoteVendor.description: Create or link a vendor from “{name}”. The supplier name on this expense stays as entered.
promoteVendor.success: Vendor linked. Supplier text on this expense was kept.

confirm.finalizeConsequence: Once finalized it cannot be edited.
confirm.voidConsequence: It will be excluded from all cost figures.

placeholders.target: Leave empty or choose a project

empty.title: Track what the business spends
empty.description: Record materials, subcontractors, rent, and other costs. Start with an amount — details can wait.

empty.title: No expenses on this project yet
empty.description: Record materials, subcontractors, and other direct costs as they happen.

allocation.title: Split allocation
allocation.empty: Split this expense across projects or overhead when one invoice covers multiple targets.

errors.workPackageRequiresProject: A work area requires a project.
errors.directFamilyRequiresProject: Direct project cost requires a project.
errors.overheadFamilyRequiresNoProject: Business overhead cannot be used on a project expense.
errors.allocationAmountRequired: Enter an amount for each fixed-amount line.
errors.allocationPercentRequired: Enter a percentage for each percent line.
errors.allocationSumMismatch: Allocation lines must sum exactly to the expense amount.
errors.allocationProjectRequired: Project allocation lines require a project.
errors.allocationOverheadNoProject: Overhead lines cannot reference a project.
errors.notEditable: Only draft expenses can be edited.
errors.notFinalizable: Only draft expenses can be finalized.
errors.notVoidable: Only finalized expenses can be voided.
errors.reversalNotVoidable: Reversal entries cannot be voided again.
errors.currencyMustMatchProject: Expense currency must match the project currency.
errors.currencyMustMatchOrganization: Overhead expense currency must match the organization currency.
errors.projectExpenseNoAllocations: Project expenses cannot be split across allocation lines.
errors.phaseProjectMismatch: The selected phase does not belong to this project.
